Intro: Good day. I'm afraid we've not been acquainted. Are you the proprietor of this establishment?
I am Lady Romirski. My husband would typically introduce us, but sadly he is no longer with us anymore.
I do hope my dreadful attire does not displease you. I am still mourning his passing.
I never had the chance to order food myself, so have patience, kind Chef. How does it go….?
Success: Thank you, this looks to be quite the delicious dish.
Fail: Has society fallen so far that this is what is deemed a delicacy?
Reject: Did I say something improper? I'm sorry, my late husband never let me leave the house by myself. Could you give me another chance, please?
